minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  October 24, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, October 10,
2019, at 2:05 pm in the Council Chambers, 9st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items

A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on
October 10, 2019.

Business License Request(s):

Item #1:  Ali Salman DBA Simply Hybrid LLC to operate a car rental at 150 W. Ivy
  Avenue, was approved for car rental/leasing in MU-2 zone and must
  comply with all applicable requirements of IMC 12-25; must have onsite
  State of California dealer's license; employees must have valid ID on
  him/herself (including any state DMV licenses if applicable); all vehicles
  must be registered, no parking of any vehicles, vehicle repairs /
  maintenance on any city streets, sidewalks or alleys; business subject to
  random inspections by any city code enforcement officer or any peace
  officer at any time to ensure compliance of the conditions of the issued
  business license and adhere to all applicable IMC regulations, and all local,
  state and federal laws. Motion carried and second. (Activity No. 00277052)

Item #2:  Ali Salman; AAA Auto Leasing DBA One Stop Classics to operate a
  car rental at 150 W. Ivy Avenue; was approved for car rental/leasing in
  MU-2 zone and must comply with all applicable requirements of IMC 12-
  25; must have onsite State of California dealer's license; employees must
  have valid ID on him/herself (including any state DMV licenses if
  applicable); all vehicles must be registered, no parking of any vehicles,
  vehicle repairs / maintenance on any city streets, sidewalks or alleys;
  business subject to random inspections by any city code enforcement
  officer or any peace officer at any time to ensure compliance of the
 Permits & License Committee  October 24, 2019
Minutes  Page 2 of 3

  conditions of the issued business license and adhere to all applicable IMC
  regulations, and all local, state and federal laws. Motion carried and
  second. (Activity No. 00277051)

Item #3:  Omar Scaife DBA Scaife Protection Services to operate a private security
  service home office at 219 Lime Street, Unit 102.; as a home occupation
  office use only; no parking of any vehicles in driveway or on any public right
  of way; applicant shall provide / submit a list of all prospective employees
  (including valid ID and applicable state BSIS permits) working within the
  city, a list of registered / insured vehicles to be used and if applicable and
  or permitted, a current list of locations where services will be rendered. In
  the interest of public safety, this business shall NOT employ or have any
  290 PC registrants employed at this establishment or any persons that may
  pose a threat to the safety of patrons or the general public and adhere to
  all applicable IMC regulations, and all local, state and federal laws. Motion
  carried and second. (Activity No. 00277132)

Item #4:  Essamall Shillen DBA Kentucky Parking Management Inc. to operate a
  parking lot for special events, for the Forum at 661 E. Manchester Terrace.
  Approval for off-site parking for special events at the Forum in existing
  parking lot; Special event parking only permitted M-F 4:00 pm to 2:00 am
  and Saturday and Sunday 7:00 am to 2:00 am, per lease agreement;
  Applicant shall provide all current & valid identification to the finance
  department prior to the issuance of license; applicant shall have adequate
  staff to attend to the vehicles being parked at all times; applicant shall allow
  unrestricted access to police, code enforcement & fire personnel at any
  time of the day or night; adhere to all applicable IMC regulations, and all
  local, state and federal laws. Motion carried and second. (Activity No.
  00277265)

Item #5:  Robert & Robeetino Altieri; BLR Enterprises, LLC DBA TCB (The Car
  Buyer) to operate a wholesale car dealer, at 4609 W. Century Boulevard;
  approval for wholesale car dealer as OFFICE USE ONLY; no vehicles to
  be displayed or sold on-site or on any public right of way; applicant shall
  provide valid ID on him/herself and all employees (including state licenses
  if applicable); No showing or sales of any vehicles, vehicle repairs /
  maintenance of vehicles on city streets, sidewalks or alleys; violators will
  be cited / towed away at owner’s expense; adhere to all applicable IMC
  regulations, and all local, state and federal laws. Motion carried and
  second. (Activity No. 00277280)

Tobacco Retailers License Renewal Request(s):
